params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name to retrieve brand data for (e.g., 'example.com', 'google.com'). Cannot be used with name or ticker parameters.

params.name: name
params.description: Company name to retrieve brand data for (e.g., 'Apple Inc'). Cannot be used with domain or ticker parameters.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol to retrieve brand data for (e.g., 'AAPL'). Cannot be used with domain or name parameters.

params.name: ticker_exchange
params.description: Stock exchange code.

params.name: force_language
params.description: Language to force for the retrieved brand data.

params.name: maxSpeed
params.description: Optional parameter to optimize the API call for maximum speed. When set to true, the API will skip time-consuming operations for faster response at the cost of less comprehensive data. Works with all three lookup methods.

params.name: maxAgeMs
params.description: Maximum age in milliseconds for cached brand data before the API performs a hard refresh. Defaults to 3 months (7776000000 ms). Values below 1 day (86400000 ms) are clamped to 1 day; values above 1 year (31536000000 ms) are clamped to 1 year.

params.name: timeoutMS
params.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the request. If the request takes longer than this value, it will be aborted with a 408 status code. Maximum allowed value is 300000ms (5 minutes).

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional comma-separated caller-defined tags for tracking this request. Tags are recorded on the request's usage log and can be used to filter usage on the dashboard usage page. Up to 20 tags, each 1-50 characters.

items.docs: Retrieve logos, backdrops, colors, industry, description, and more from any domain

Retrieve logos, backdrops, colors, industry, description, and more. Provide exactly one lookup identifier in the request body: a domain, company name, email address, stock ticker, transaction descriptor, or direct URL. Note: `by_direct_url` fetches brand data only from the provided URL — not from the entire internet.
